criteria: Freeze source, config and encounter assets before the first native capture. One fresh attempt per declared cell; never retry/overwrite failures.
All runs: capture integrity audit (native NVIDIA GPU, raw paired depth, numeric TF, costmaps, cleanup) must PASS independently from behavior.
Robot physical screen: action SUCCEEDED with independent world XY<=.20m/yaw<=.25rad, positive swept robot/human and continuous static clearance; count all progress failures/recoveries.

Gap screen: actual bounding-circle passage across x=-24 inside the declared aperture, positive continuous static clearance, actual goal and no recovery. Compare v6 originals as reference; no promotion from social-only outcomes.

Social near-encounter coverage: at least one native robot/human center distance<=1.5m, with at least .5s cumulative active duration (union over humans). Separately measure minimum distance. If absent, mark NOT_EXERCISED instead of claiming avoidance PASS.

Initial-intent coverage: head-on native member vx<-.05m/s or crossing abs(vy)>.05m/s for at least1s during first12s; report changes of native group goals. Actual near encounters and coverage are outcomes, not guaranteed by the fixture name.

Human diagnostics: first12s and whole-run cumulative absolute yaw, yaw per metre, speed/facing alignment, centroid/member spread, human/human and human/static swept clearance; report native goal-wall-clock ages/changes. Compare legacy/adapter under matching initial conditions, not matching subsequent ego inputs.
No goal/progress tolerance loosening, forced robot cmd_vel or waypoint, robot model or default ROS changes. Seed45/one native attempt per cell cannot establish robustness; MPPI RNG not pinned.

Native human goal expiry uses host wall time, not sim time. Initial directions/goals are forced only at initialization; native retargeting/lifecycle then remain active. Results do not constitute naturalness or WM/RL training acceptance.
